groups.saying_opens: في رجل تزوج امرأة فمات عنها
سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads (rule 4a): Abd Allah's judgement is saying 1; Ma'qil's report of the Prophet's judgement in the case of Bari' is saying 2
Saying 2 names no transmitter before Ma'qil in the text, so its chain is that Companion alone; the head is not repeated
